results.releaseNotes:
Tasks has a new design, and reviews, docs, a calendar, labels and due dates.

New in this version:
• A new window: All Tasks and Reviews across every board in the sidebar
• Board, List and Calendar views, with filters and search in the toolbar (Command-K)
• Sort tasks by newest, oldest or due date
• Command-N starts a new task on the open board, or lets you pick one
• Drop a card anywhere in a lane, also between two cards
• A new task panel with details, activity and files, and comments
• Open a task in a window of its own with a double-click
• Notes are shown as rendered Markdown and you edit them right there
• Reviews from all your boards in one place, newest first
• Docs kept in the board's repository
• Labels and due dates on tasks
• Board settings: add, rename and merge members, priorities and products right in the list, including names agents wrote on tasks
• Notifications for new reviews and board changes
• When a new board appears in a repository you added, Tasks offers to add it
• A dark navy look in place of the translucent window
results.description:
Tasks is a native Mac app for task boards backed by a git repository of markdown files. Each card is a markdown file with simple frontmatter, each lane is a folder, and the whole board lives in a repo you own, so you keep full history and your data stays portable.

Sign in to GitHub with device-flow OAuth, or connect GitHub, GitLab.com or a self-hosted GitLab with a personal access token. There is no hosted service and no separate account: you bring your own git host, and your token is stored in the Keychain.

Boards
• Keep the boards of several repositories in one sidebar, each with its own icon and color
• See at a glance which boards changed since you last opened them
• All Tasks shows the open tasks of every board, and Reviews collects what your boards ask you to approve
• View a board as lanes, as a list or as a calendar, with backlog lanes loaded on demand
• Drag cards between lanes and drop them anywhere, also between two cards
• Labels, due dates, comments and an activity log on every task
• Keep docs next to the board, in the same repository
• Filter by project, assignee, priority or type, and search your cards full text
• Create projects with seeded lanes, and edit lanes, priorities, members, types and epics
• Open a folder on your Mac, or a folder server on your network, as a board

Edit in place
• Open a task in the side panel, or in a window of its own with a double-click
• Notes are shown as rendered Markdown, and you edit them right there
• Change lane, priority, type, epic and assignee from the card's chips
• Open the card's markdown file in your own editor
• Each change is saved as a commit

For your coding agents
• Turn on Agent Access and agents on your Mac can read and update your boards through the app, as a local MCP server
• Agents list and read cards, create and claim them, update fields, move lanes and attach screenshots
• The board's own rules and templates are handed to the agent, and values the board does not allow are refused
• It listens on your Mac only and requires a token

Also
• Notifications for new reviews and board changes, if you want them
• Optional live updates when someone pushes, through a small relay you can host yourself
• Try a demo board first, with no account or connection

Tasks works over your provider's API, so there is no local clone to manage. The board is just files and folders in your repo, readable and editable with any git tool. It shares its board format with Tasks for iPhone and iPad, so the same board opens on both.

Tasks was called GitKittie Kanban before this version.
